wheat.definition: A cereal plant whose grains are ground into flour.

oats.definition: A cereal grain commonly used in porridge and baked foods.

barley.definition: A grain used as food, in animal feed, and to make beer.

quinoa.definition: Small edible seeds cooked and used in meals like a grain.

corn.definition: A tall cereal plant with yellow grains used for food or animal feed.
corn.exampleUsage: The corn was identified during the lesson.

millet.definition: A grain with small seeds, used as food.

buckwheat.definition: Edible seeds used like a grain or ground into flour.

rye.definition: A grain often used to make dark bread.

bulgur.definition: Wheat that has been boiled, dried, and broken into small pieces.

toast.definition: Bread heated until its surface becomes brown and crisp.

bagel.definition: (Yiddish) glazed yeast-raised doughnut-shaped roll with hard crust.

croissant.definition: A light, flaky pastry shaped like a crescent.

baguette.definition: A long, thin loaf with a crisp crust.

pita.definition: A round pocket of bread that can hold fillings.

tortilla.definition: Thin unleavened pancake made from cornmeal or wheat flour.

muffin.definition: A small sweet baked cake, often with fruit or chocolate.

roll.definition: A small individual piece of bread.

sourdough.definition: Bread made with fermented dough and a slightly sour taste.

spaghetti.definition: Pasta made in long thin strands.

penne.definition: Pasta in short tubes with diagonally cut ends.

fettuccine.definition: Pasta in flat strips wider than linguine.

linguine.definition: Pasta in long slender flat strips.

ravioli.definition: Small circular or square cases of dough with savory fillings.

lasagna.definition: Baked dish of layers of lasagna pasta with sauce and cheese and meat or vegetables.

ramen.definition: Japanese-style wheat noodles, often served in broth.

udon.definition: Thick noodles from Japan are made with wheat flour, water, and salt. People serve them in hot or cold dishes.

rice-noodle.definition: A noodle made mainly from rice flour and water.

yogurt.definition: A thick dairy food made by fermenting milk with bacteria.

cream.definition: The thick, rich part of milk used in cooking or desserts.

sour-cream.definition: A light dairy cream deliberately given a tangy, sour taste.

cottage-cheese.definition: A mild, soft white cheese made from curds formed when skim milk sours.

cream-cheese.definition: A soft, smooth cheese often spread on bread.

whipped-cream.definition: Cream that has been beaten so air makes it light and fluffy.
whipped-cream.exampleUsage: A spoonful of whipped cream topped the dessert.

ice-cream.definition: A cold, frozen dessert usually made with milk or cream, sugar, and added flavorings.

egg-white.definition: The clear or whitish part of an egg surrounding the yolk.
egg-white.exampleUsage: The recipe used two egg whites.

egg-yolk.definition: The yellow central part of an egg.
egg-yolk.exampleUsage: The egg yolk was separated from the white.

tofu.definition: A soft or firm food made by coagulating soy milk into curds.

tempeh.definition: A firm fermented food made mainly from cooked soybeans bound together into a cake.
tempeh.exampleUsage: Tempeh was sliced and cooked with vegetables.

seitan.definition: A high-protein food made mainly from wheat gluten, often used as a meat substitute.

plant-milk.definition: A non-dairy drink made by processing plant ingredients such as grains, nuts, seeds, or legumes with water.
plant-milk.exampleUsage: The café offers several types of plant milk.

almond-milk.definition: A plant-based drink made from almonds and water.
almond-milk.exampleUsage: She used almond milk in the cereal.

oat-milk.definition: A plant-based drink made from oats and water.
oat-milk.exampleUsage: Oat milk has a mild cereal flavor.

soy-milk.definition: A plant-based drink made from soybeans and water.
soy-milk.exampleUsage: Soy milk can be used in many recipes.

rice.definition: Starchy cereal grains boiled as a dietary staple.

bread.definition: A staple baked loaf produced from flour dough.

milk.definition: A white nutrient-rich liquid food from dairy cows.

butter.definition: Churned dairy fat used for cooking and spreads.

egg.definition: An oval hard-shelled reproductive food laid by chickens.
